title: angelica cartilaginomarginata var. makinoi
intro: Angelica cartilaginomarginata var. makinoi, commonly known as Japanese angelica, is a perennial plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae) that is native to East Asia. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, as well as potential uses in treating conditions such as fever and rheumatism. Therapeutically, Japanese angelica is believed to exhibit expectorant and anti-inflammatory actions, which may help to alleviate respiratory issues and reduce inflammation. The plant's bioactive constituents include coumarins, sesquiterpenes, and lignans, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic effects.
